items.title: [TEST] Verify the empty wish panel with the sky backdrop on an account without wishes
items.description: Batch note #6 moved the wish sky behind the empty state (wish-empty.component.ts, wish-sky variant backdrop) and behind the top of the wish window (wish-cart-dialog.component.ts). Specs pass, but the empty popout could not be seen live: the test account has wishes. Check on an account with an empty wish list: the sky sits behind title, hint and button, no framed box, the empty popout is shorter than before (old box 136 px + gap), and reduced motion stops the shooting star.

items.title: [FEATURE] Patch changes tab for non-ship detail pages
items.description: The shared detail shell (src/app/codex/detail/codex-detail-shell.component.ts, codex-detail-profile.ts) hides a tab without data. The approved tab set for items includes Änderungen (patch differences, as on the ship), but items have no patch history on the detail page, so the tab never shows. Needs a data source per item and patch before it can appear.

items.title: [REFACTOR] Move the ship holotable body into the shared detail shell
items.description: Batch note #3 asked for one template for all detail pages. Built: one shared head band, tab pill and panel (codex-detail-shell + kind profile) used by ship and item pages. The ship's holotable body (codex-holo-stage.component.ts, ~2950 lines) still renders inside its own component and its panel tabs do not yet use the shared tab pill. Follow-up: render the holotable as the ship profile's stage inside the shell so panel and strip are fully shared.
